title: Inconsistent animation stopping condition in the editor when using AnimationPlayer + AnimationTree
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.1, v4.8.dev.custom_build [d488d1111].

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (d488d1111) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When working with both the AnimationPlayer and the AnimationTree you may need to change your animation while its being used by the AnimationTree.

Now the animation tree stops if you click on the animation player RIGHT AFTER using the animation tree. If you click on any other nodes it won't STOP and will continue playing and if then you click the animation player you won't be able to seek any animation until you switch the nodes in the correct order (click on them in the correct order, or change the docks in that order).

Otherwise if you click on the animation player right after using the animation tree, the animation won't START playing until you click on the animation tree because clicking on any nodes won't trigger the animation tree.

That means every time you need to change your animation you MUST click on the nodes (or switch the docks) in the correct order, otherwise you won't be able to preview any animation (you can still add keyframes while its playing but the usefulness of that is debatable).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b839ea9f-8360-4274-946d-6d6ac3eead37

(And if anything I didn't even know you could stop the animation tree in the editor. There is a proposal for that https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9072)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have a scene with both the AnimationPlayer and the AnimationTree.
2. Have an animation in the animation player and have it play through the animation tree using the AnimationNodeBlendTree.
3. Then click on the animation tree and then click on the animation player - the animation will stop.
4. Then click on the animation tree, click on any of your animated nodes, then click on the animation player - the animation won't stop playing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[animation_editor_confusion_2026-07-29_13-54-55.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30501867/animation_editor_confusion_2026-07-29_13-54-55.zip)
